verdict.rationale: All three distribution routes in the story are documented. Teams can commit skills to the project: Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repo root, and teams can check in folder-specific skills. Repo and local marketplaces are named as team-distribution sources, added with `codex plugin marketplace add`, and skills can be packaged as plugins for others to install. A runtime probe confirmed the public marketplace manifest and a real install that landed a skill in `.agents/skills`. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of a private team repo marketplace end-to-end, and clarity on surface-by-surface availability of repo marketplaces (docs note it varies).
